limitations: The 1,852 names are exact string differences, including harmless capitalization/abbreviations; not all are wrong.

Missing temperature hours are detected between consecutive readings in each facility; boundary gaps are not included.
Do not infer named blood unit-to-refrigerator relationships or validate clinical cold-chain dispositions.
Site-specific equipment SOPs are required for clinical interpretation.
